image_prompt: Peter, an ethereal young boy appearing no more than twelve years old, with an androgynous delicate beauty. He has pale, luminous skin with an otherworldly quality, as if touched by moonlight. His hair is tousled and fine, appearing dark blonde or light brown with an almost silvery sheen, falling softly around his face in romantic waves. His features are sharp yet innocent—high cheekbones, a pointed chin, and large, luminous eyes that gleam with mischievous intelligence and timeless melancholy. His gaze holds an ancient, knowing quality despite his youthful appearance. He wears a simple but elegant costume of soft green and brown tones, reminiscent of fairy-tale illustrations, with subtle iridescent qualities suggesting otherworldly magic. His slender, graceful frame conveys supernatural lightness and preternatural agility. Around him hovers an ethereal luminescence, as if he exists partially between worlds. His expression balances boyish wonder with something darker and more complex—a blend of innocence and mischief tinged with bittersweet knowing. He appears poised mid-movement, capturing an essence of perpetual youth frozen in time.
